rows.ARS:
Medium red Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Corrida®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Bernard Sauvageot (France, 1995).
Introduced in France by NIRP International / Lux Riviera in 2005 as 'Corrida'.
rows.Bloom: Red. Strawberry red. 30 petals. Average diameter 4.25". Full (26-40 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower or exhibition.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
